products.name: Marketo Qualifier
products.title: Adobe Marketo Qualifier
products.what: Adobe's app for business development representatives, part of the Marketo product family. Its Account Qualification Agent reads your client's CRM and Marketo engagement data, prioritizes prospects and accounts, proposes outreach cadences of email, phone and LinkedIn steps, and drafts a personalized email for each prospect, which a representative reviews and approves before it is sent.

source.title: Experience League: Adobe Marketo Qualifier

products.notes: Adobe provisions the app; the setup that follows is groups in the Admin Console and a CRM connection. No email goes out until a representative has reviewed and approved it, so the first weeks are as much about your client's sales team as about configuration. Marketo Qualifier reads Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365 through API credentials your client's CRM administrator prepares, with one CRM active at a time, and writes back only logged outreach activities, opt-out status and the field updates set in CRM Sync Rules. Phone calls and LinkedIn InMails are tasks a representative completes by hand: the app writes the call script or the InMail text and the representative sends it from LinkedIn. Adobe's integration page documents the Outlook connection; the profile settings page also names Google as an email choice without setup steps, so MQ03 is written for Outlook. AI person summaries on a prospect's profile show only on instances running Marketo Optimizer Prime or Ultimate, and no line rests on them. The chat inbox, routing rules and meeting bookings used with Brand Concierge are described in Adobe's Brand Concierge guide, not in the Marketo Qualifier guide (see the mqualifier-bc connection); that guide also gives the app's earlier name, Sales Qualifier. Hours are our own estimates for a mid-market sales team; Adobe publishes none.
prereqs: Marketo Qualifier provisioned by Adobe for your client's organization
An Admin Console administrator at your client who holds the Adobe Experience Platform product or is a System Administrator, to create the user groups
Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics 365, with API credentials prepared by your client's CRM administrator; one CRM is active at a time
Read access for the connection to leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities and activities, and write access where activities, opt-outs or status updates go back to the CRM
An Outlook mailbox and calendar for each representative, and a Microsoft 365 administrator's approval where your client has turned off user consent to third-party apps
Your client's sales plays, ideal customer profiles and positioning guides in PDF, PPTX or DOCX, for the Knowledge Center

connections.how: It runs in two directions. Marketo Engage sends live activity to Marketo Qualifier through a webhook: an administrator creates OAuth Server-to-Server credentials in the Adobe Developer Console, sets up the webhook in Marketo Engage with Adobe's payload template and headers, and adds it as a Call Webhook step to a trigger Smart Campaign whose triggers decide which activities are sent. Representatives then see and filter prospects by that activity under Marketing Highlights, and an Outbound Workflow can enroll prospects whose activity matches its targeting. In the other direction, activity sync writes Marketo Qualifier outreach activities to Marketo Engage, and representatives can add a contact to a Marketo campaign from the account view or from Salesforce.

not_documented.why: No setup documented on any Marketo Qualifier page. The guide names Marketo Optimizer four ways: as a member of the Marketo family, as a product the app supports, as the tier that shows AI person summaries (Prime or Ultimate, kept as a tier on the product), and as data AI Chat can read. None of the 16 pages has a step that connects the two. The Marketo Optimizer guide's overview describes Marketo Qualifier in one paragraph and links to its documentation, again without setup. Marketo Optimizer is another helper's product; no connection is written from this side.
not_documented.quote: AI Chat can answer questions across your Marketo Qualifier, CRM, Marketo, Marketo Optimizer, and company intelligence data.

not_documented.why: Named once, in the list of the Marketo product family on the guide home. No page describes data moving between the two or a setup step.

not_documented.why: Journey Optimizer B2B Edition appears only as a heading over four sample questions for AI Chat. Adobe says these lookups read and report; no page describes setup between the two products.

not_documented.why: Shared plumbing, not a connection. The user group is given an Adobe Experience Platform product profile, the Marketing Highlights credentials are created on the Experience Platform API, and the webhook carries an Experience Platform sandbox name. No page describes Real-Time CDP audiences or profiles moving to or from Marketo Qualifier.
